name: Missa
title: Descendants of Benjamin
summary: Missa is a person mentioned in the biblical genealogies in 1 Chronicles. He is a descendant of Benjamin, one of the twelve tribes of Israel. His significance lies primarily in his place in the genealogical line recorded after the exile to preserve Israel's tribal identity.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Benjamin's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Missa is recorded as one of the sons of Elaal in Benjamin's genealogical register, which preserved the family line after the Babylonian exile.

keyEvents.title: Benjamin's Descendants in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: The genealogies in 1 Chronicles were compiled to restore tribal identity after the return from Babylon. Missa is part of this important register.

keyEvents.title: Settlement of the Tribe of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: The descendants of Benjamin, including the lineage of Misha, were registered among those who lived in various cities in the promised land.

keyEvents.title: Part of the lineage of Beriah
keyEvents.description: Misha belongs to the broader lineage of Beriah, who was an important family head among the Benjamites living in Aijalon.
